findings.title: update_status stamps CRITICAL permits/insurance ACTIVE (or NOT_APPLICABLE) with empty docs → critical_missing=0 and 100% compliance_rate

attack_chain.who: Colluding contractor + PM with API access
attack_chain.sink: get_compliance_summary.critical_missing only counts PENDING/EXPIRED; ACTIVE and NOT_APPLICABLE clear the work-stoppage gate (Priority.CRITICAL comment L59)
attack_chain.gain: Official compliance report shows work authorized (building permit/insurance) without issued documents; project proceeds / owner dashboard green

findings.not_stub: Full ComplianceTracker with enums, alerts, Excel/report generation, and CRITICAL=work-stoppage semantics; used as system of record for regulatory gates
findings.not_duplicate: Not permit DRAFT→ISSUED (different skill/functions). Prior soft near-miss undervalued NOT_APPLICABLE + empty-doc ACTIVE clearing critical_missing

findings.title: _get_availability aggregates overlapping allocations with max() instead of sum() → overbooks shared crane/crew beyond capacity

attack_chain.who: Colluding PMs scheduling multiple projects against one shared crane/crew pool
attack_chain.sink: allocated = max(allocated, alloc.quantity) undercounts concurrent demand; allocate() believes capacity remains
attack_chain.gain: Official ALLOCATED status for 1.2+ of capacity-1.0 crane → unsafe concurrent lifts / ghost capacity on portfolio schedule

findings.not_stub: Production-style pool with conflict detection, utilization reports, and auto_allocate used for live resource decisions
findings.not_duplicate: Not crane capacity ignore (site-logistics unused Equipment.capacity). This is a concurrent overbook arithmetic bug in a different skill

findings.title: Attacker-controlled percent_complete flows into calculate_earned_value BCWP / export without progress verification

attack_chain.sink: bcwp += budgeted_cost * percent_complete / 100 → SPI/CPI/EAC; Excel export BCWP(EV)
attack_chain.gain: Forge earned value (e.g. 10%→100% on $1M = $900k overbill basis) driving pay apps / owner progress payments

findings.not_stub: Full cost-loaded schedule + cash flow + EVM export marketed as project controls system of record
findings.not_duplicate: Not pay-app processor overbill+unapproved CO. This forges the EV inputs those payment systems consume

findings.title: _filter_eligible treats missing cert/license valid_until as date.max; self-reported incident_rate/insurance drive award scores

attack_chain.who: Colluding contractor registering their own profile
attack_chain.controls: certifications/licenses without valid_until (or far-future), incident_rate=0, insurance_coverage inflated, forged references
attack_chain.sink: Eligibility filter accepts eternal certs; safety/financial scores inflate; find_matches / recommendation report ranks attacker #1
attack_chain.gain: Official award recommendation / bid evaluation favors unqualified or expired-cert contractor

findings.not_stub: Full matching engine with eligibility gates, weighted scoring, bid evaluation, Excel recommendation report
findings.not_duplicate: Not prequal EMR QUALIFIED status jump. Mechanism is expiry fail-open + self-attested scores in contractor-matching-ai

findings.title: check_ppe_compliance: attacker-controlled required_ppe=[] yields COMPLIANT with zero actual PPE; check_work_activity trusts self-attested permits/PPE/fire_watch

attack_chain.who: Contractor submitting worker/activity payloads to automated safety gate
attack_chain.sink: COMPLIANT ComplianceCheck records / inspection overall_score used as work-authorization evidence
attack_chain.gain: Official COMPLIANT PPE/hot-work/confined-space/fall-protection status without real controls → unsafe work proceeds

findings.not_stub: OSHA-referenced rules engine producing ComplianceCheck + SiteInspection scores and dashboard metrics
findings.not_duplicate: Not Field-Ops safety-inspection stats forge (created=completed KPI). This forges COMPLIANT via empty required set / self-attest in a different skill
